grammar.summary: 本课学习年龄表达与 must 表承诺义务。

points.title: be + 数词 + years old
points.explanation: 问年龄 How old are you? 回答 I'm sixteen years old.（16岁可省略为 I'm sixteen.）表"已经不小了"说 You're not a baby!

examples.en: How old are you this year?

points.title: must 表许诺式义务
points.explanation: 向家长保证时：I promise I'll be good.（will 表意愿）You must be home at half past ten.（must 表规定的义务）。
